title: GTA 6 Police Will Hunt You Down with Dogs, Says Polygon
description: According to a Polygon report, Rockstar's attention to detail in GTA 6 extends to the police force, which will feature dogs hunting down players.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Police Force to Feature Dog Tracking System

As anticipation continues to build for Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster, new insights into the game's development and mechanics are constantly emerging. A recent report from gaming media outlet Polygon has shed light on the incredible level of detail being poured into the police force of *GTA 6*.

### Next-Level Attention to Detail on Law Enforcement

According to Polygon, Rockstar's commitment to detail during the development of *GTA 6* is next-level. This extreme level of polish does not just reflect on the main characters, but is heavily integrated into the game's police force as well. The report highlights that the authorities will be more formidable than ever, presenting players with entirely new challenges when attempting to evade law enforcement in the game's setting.

Most notably, Polygon notes that the police will actually hunt down players using dogs. This mechanic introduces a fresh layer of complexity to the classic wanted level system, forcing players to adapt their escape strategies to deal with canine pursuers. While the source report does not elaborate on further gameplay mechanics, this single detail highlights a deep commitment to realism and immersive pursuit dynamics.

### Building on Rockstar's Open-World Legacy

Rockstar has long been celebrated for pushing the boundaries of artificial intelligence and interactive open worlds. Industry analysis and fan speculation suggest that incorporating specialized units like tracking dogs is a natural evolution of the systemic depth seen in previous titles. It emphasizes a world where actions have escalating, realistic consequences.

## Editor's Take

Polygon's report offers an exciting glimpse into the meticulous design behind *GTA 6*. The addition of police dogs hunting players down shows that Rockstar isn't just scaling up the map size, but also deepening the systemic interactions. It's safe to say that evading the law in Vice City is going to be much more challenging and thrilling than ever before.
